note: House League shop upgrades (docs/ROADMAP.md: 6 of 16), written and landed together by E18-C07. Prices and amounts are provisional (E24).

design.trigger: The first reroll in each Pro Shop visit is free; later rerolls follow the usual $2, $3, ... sequence.
design.pool: Pro Shop License offer (one per Division, kept through rerolls); initial pool from Division 1.
design.presentation_needs: A punched loyalty card on the reroll button; the button shows 'Reroll free' until used.

design.trigger: Adds a third reserve slot for pins for the rest of the attempt. Reserves hold pins between matches and feed Reserve Call.
design.pool: Pro Shop License offer (one per Division, kept through rerolls); initial pool from Division 1.
design.presentation_needs: A caddy case beside the rack summary with three pockets; the new pocket is visibly added on purchase.

design.trigger: Every Pro Shop offer, including the License offer, costs $1 less, never below $1. Sale values stay half the price actually paid, so nothing can be resold at a profit.
design.pool: Pro Shop License offer (one per Division, kept through rerolls); initial pool from Division 2.
design.presentation_needs: A red clearance tag on every offer price; the struck-through original price shows beside the new one.

design.trigger: Raises the interest cap from $3 to $5: interest still pays $1 per $5 held when a match ends, now up to $5.
design.pool: Pro Shop License offer (one per Division, kept through rerolls); initial pool from Division 2.
design.presentation_needs: A passbook in the settlement line; the interest row shows the raised cap.

design.trigger: The Pro Shop shows one more offer every visit, drawn from any category it sells (Charm, ball, pin, tactical card or modification), from the next stock onward.
design.pool: Pro Shop License offer (one per Division, kept through rerolls); initial pool from Division 2.
design.presentation_needs: A sixth shelf with its own 'Extra Shelf' label among the offers.

design.trigger: Uncommon and rare offers come up more often: rarity odds become common 40%, uncommon 38%, rare 18%, epic 4% (from 55/30/12/3), from the next stock onward.
design.pool: Pro Shop License offer (one per Division, kept through rerolls); initial pool from Division 3.
design.presentation_needs: A spotlight over the offer grid; rarity frames glow brighter while it is owned.
